messages.subject: g.shell.GGIR Part 1 Error
parts:
Hello everyone, 

Oddly enough, for a specific file, I noticed that using `g.shell.GGIR` (specified for only part 1) produces the following error:

"Errors and warnings for ****.bin$message
[1] "non-numeric argument to mathematical function","

yet g.getmeta runs without issue and produces the desired metashort file. 

Any help is appreciated.

Kind regards,
Michael

Note: for privacy reasons, the name of the .bin file was changed to "****" (although not actually the name when implementing the function).

messages.author: c4bb1002428326c2
messages.subject: Re: g.shell.GGIR Part 1 Error
parts:
Apparently I posted too soon, but maybe this can be helpful to others. 

After some investigation, the function cooperated when I specified `f1=1` and `do.parallel = F`. 

Best,
Michael
